name: bids.town
one_liner: A Minecraft-style voxel city that is also an auction — $1 claims a plot, ad spend grows your building and buys advertising surfaces across the town.

stack.runtime: React 19.2.8 (pinned exactly for the r3f peer range)
stack.ui: Tailwind v4, @theme inline tokens, zero dark: variants
stack.backend: Supabase (Postgres, service-role only, RLS with zero policies)
stack.payments: Stripe Checkout — SHARED ACCOUNT with productbids, see learnings

forked_from: productbids.lol — auction mechanics, scoring, anti-abuse and design tokens reused wholesale
notes: LIVE 2026-08-22 on https://bids.town — shared Supabase (own bidstown schema) + shared Stripe (metadata.product guard both sides). Payment round-trip pending first $1 claim.
